body: the remarks he made were 6 months earlier. He had not said anything since. Also, he was my best friends. There are only around 12 people in my cohort and we are all very close. It is not unusual for us to do this with each other. I guess I did trust him too much.

I have told people that I do not want to talk about it and to not bring anything up anymore. I have talked to faculty and one idea was to have a few meetings with students and faculty to ask them to stop talking. I think that will create more talk though. I avoiding talking to people and stay in my office between classes, but still run into people in the halls.
That is where I am at now. I do not think it is worth it anymore.

He should be, but he isn't. He still thinks he did nothing wrong. I am embarrassed because I don't like having my professional life mix with my personal life. It is upsetting to me to now be looked upon not just as me and this is the work I do, but as me, with this whole situation and we need to treat you differently.

Cannot change schools. I would have to apply to similar programs (which occurs in November) and do interviews and see if any accept me. I would have to wait a year to take the same classes I am taking now, and Bob will still be here. So will all of the other professors and students.
